title: A covector coordinate is bounded by the Euclidean coefficient norm
statement: For all P, n ∈ ℕ, every n-covector α ∈ Covector (Eucl P) n and every strictly increasing multi-index β ∈ SimonMultiIndex n P (an order embedding Fin n ↪o Fin P): |α(e_β)| ≤ |α|. Here α(e_β) := euclideanCovectorCoordinate α β = α(e_{β(0)}, …, e_{β(n−1)}) with e_i = EuclideanSpace.single i 1, and |α| := covectorEuclideanNorm α = √(Σ_{I : Fin n → Fin P} [I strictly increasing]·α(b_{I(0)}, …, b_{I(n−1)})²) with b_i = EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin P) ℝ i.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (α : Covector (Eucl P) n) (β : SimonMultiIndex n P), |euclideanCovectorCoordinate α β| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α
